## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended Unresolved correctness issues remain in `bin/validate-plugins`, along with test portability and runtime-budget concerns. **Review effort:** Lite **Findings:** 1 · 1
Open (2) - [Use shared validator path variable for scrut temporary directories](#discussion_r4162430298) · New - [Documentation step redundantly renames the file to its current path](#discussion_r4162430336) · New
What changed in this PR This PR optimizes plugin validation and cross-reference checks, splits the Scrut suite, and restores a 10-minute CI timeout. **Changes:** - Batch validation and scanning operations to reduce process overhead. - Move validator cases into a dedicated Scrut document. - Document and enforce runtime budgeting. | File | Review summary | |---|---| | `tests/​scrut/​validate-plugins.md` | Moderate (3 votes): use the shared `VALIDATE_PLUGINS_BIN` environment variable. | | `tests/​scrut/​repo-tooling.md` | No findings. | | `tests/​AGENTS.md` | Moderate (1 vote): do not document an unachieved half-ceiling budget. | | `docs/​plans/​todo/​2026-10-01-budget-scrut-suite-runtime.md` | Nit (2 votes): replace the stale rename step. | | `bin/​validate-plugins` | Critical (2 votes): preserve newline-containing JSON strings; moderate (1 vote): correct UTF-8 character counting. | | `bin/​check-cross-references` | No findings. | | `.github/​workflows/​ci.yml` | Moderate (1 vote): verify or revise the stricter half-ceiling policy. |
